parsed.title: Table row ends with stray '|---|' separator fragment
parsed.detail: The new 0.10.0 row ends with `... publish the re-bundle. |---|` — a table-separator fragment appended to the data row, corrupting the markdown table. Same artifact on the workflow-status 3.5.0 (~line 158), review-change 3.5.1 (~line 391), fold-findings 1.5.0 (~line 442) and triage-issue 2.8.0 (~line 552) rows.

parsed.title: Header separator dropped a column
parsed.detail: The diff changes the table header separator from `|---|---|---|---|` to `|---|---|---|` while the rows still carry 4 cells (Version|Date|Type|What changed), so the changed tables (package, workflow-status, review-change, fold-findings, triage-issue) render with a mismatched separator row.

parsed.title: Same stray '|---|' and 3-column separator in Spanish file
parsed.detail: Identical defects mirrored: 0.10.0 row ends `... publicar el re-empaquetado. |---|`, and the header separator is reduced to `|---|---|---|` under 4-cell rows (also on workflow-status 3.5.0, review-change 3.5.1, fold-findings 1.5.0, triage-issue 2.8.0 rows).

parsed.title: review-change 3.5.1 labeled 'patch' but changes routing behavior
parsed.detail: The versioning policy defines patch as 'wording, examples, clarifications…; no behavior change.' The 3.5.1 entry states the Routing table and REVIEW-FAIL `→ Next:` block now route `replan-in-unit` through `node scripts/unit-route.mjs <unit>` 'replacing the two contradictory sentences that sent the class to the executor and to `plan-feature`' — a changed routing case, which the policy classifies as minor ('a new routing case'). Same mismatch in CHANGELOG.es.md ('parche').

parsed.title: workflow-status 3.5.0 text garbled: 'no open row contributes nothing'
parsed.detail: The entry reads 'a plain fix-now row to `/fold-findings`, no open row contributes nothing' — a double negative that contradicts the intended schema-declared behavior (an empty suggestion array contributes nothing); as written it asserts an open row does contribute nothing, contradicting the first clause that a plan-owned open finding routes to the planner.

parsed.title: replan-findings 1.0.0 has no bump type
parsed.detail: The new skill row uses '—' in the Type column while the policy table only defines major/minor/patch; the entry also claims 'no planning preflight' and 'never straight to `/execute-phase`' without a stated validator/test receipt, unlike every other mechanized change in these tables which names its validator script.
